the highest yield of maize crop was achieved by the interaction of 36 kg K2 O fed with 50 mg B fed L.

maize grain yield, stalk yield and its quality were increased with increasing K fertilization rates as soil and /or foliar with borate.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the effect of potassium and boronic fertilizer on maize crop growth and yield.
the importance of K and B fertilizers in maize production and their synergetic relationship.
the response of maize (Zea maize c.v. yellow single hybrid 268) crop to potassium (K) and/or foliar applied boron (B).
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
K fertilization as soil and/or as foliar with B fertilization as foliar is a good strategy for improving maize crop yield and quality under the present study conditions.
the interaction between K fertilization rate and foliar applied boron significantly increased grain and straw yield and their quality.

The main takeaway from our work is that

K and B fertilizations are essential for maize crop production under the studied conditions, and that foliar applications of these nutrients are more effective than soil applications, and that folia applied 50 mg L B was the most profitable rate of boron.
